checklists.answer: waaseyaa/ai-tools is a PHP >=8.5 library with PSR-4 namespace and a provider; its declared public-surface file is source authority.
Ten declared public symbols; 33 @api-only and ten unclassified exports still need complete installed consumer and lifecycle disposition.
The sampled registry lazily hydrates manifest tools, refuses duplicate names and distinguishes optional-dependency skip from other resolution errors.
Allowlist and capability-scoped registries narrow visibility; dispatch retains the caller principal for the tool's own capability enforcement.
Advertised input schema is validated before execution; audited dispatch refuses absent/null ledgers and records or refuses terminal paths.
The HTTP bridge preserves live envelope/log compatibility and delegates shared dispatch, but exact candidate installed HTTP and terminal side effects were not qualified.
Symfony DependencyInjection 7.4.13 is installed; lazy manifest and provider-order equivalence needs a bounded comparison before a retain or replace verdict.
